plugins.description: Agent Skills by wl2bd. Currently: naming-things, a process for naming a product, company, library or feature (brief, wide generation, screening, argued shortlist, domain checks at the registry); discreet-design, which keeps a screen quiet by cutting extra cards, icons and colour before drawing, and treats a first version as smaller, not sloppier.
